Thanks — calendar invite sent for Tue Mar 16 14:00–14:30 PT (link included). Quick answers to your prep questions and run-of-show:

KMS/BYOK: Yes — Redwood supports BYOK for Dedicated and Private deployments. We integrate with AWS KMS / GCP KMS and can support customer-managed keys backed by HSM. Neha will be the technical owner and can provide key-rotation and access-control docs during the call. See attached redwood-kms-diagram.png for the high-level flow.

Retention/Log history: For Dedicated/private we can configure retention up to 13 months; for hosted default is 90 days but we can export historical snapshots on request (subject to the export window and cost). We'll capture exact retention SLAs in the follow-up.

Evidence delivery: We support both presigned S3 uploads for one-time evidence drops and a secure portal for SOC2 artifacts. For small sample bundles presigned S3 is easiest — Ben will circulate a runbook (log-sample-instructions.pdf) with the exact steps.

Run-of-show (30 min):
- 0–5min: intros + scope (Marissa/Samantha)
- 5–15min: CAIQ/SIG mapping overview + what Velari should prepare (Marissa)
- 15–25min: Log export/runbook overview + KMS Qs (Ben / Neha)
- 25–30min: Action items and next steps (Marissa)

Action items assigned now:

- Samantha/Tom: confirm artifact recipient list for SOC2 and who will upload (S3 vs portal).
